barriers._note: Railings and walls: how they look (height, thickness, colour) and their collider, which is always at least minThickness thick and taller than what's drawn so a car can't hop or slip through. auto: railings the map often doesn't have — on both sides of every bridge, along motorway edges, and beside a road where the ground drops away (more than drop m within reach m of its edge, for at least minRun m).
